transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess my family wanted me to come, mostly. I don’t want to make a big scene or anything, but there’s been this problem with money. They keep telling me the bank papers show nothing was taken, and maybe I’m not explaining it right, but I’ve known for over a year that they’re hiding my money.

They use things like bills, fundraisers, and trip plans to cover it up, and then everyone acts like I’m the one being difficult when I ask about it. I just… I need them to tell the truth, so I keep bringing it up. That’s why I’m here, I think.
What makes you certain that your family is hiding your money?

I mean… I know it sounds like I’m being hard on them, and I don’t want you to think I’m just trying to accuse people. But it’s been going on for more than a year.

They keep showing me bank papers and saying, “See, nothing was taken,” but that doesn’t feel like the whole truth. The money keeps getting explained away with bills, or some fundraiser, or plans for a trip, and it’s always like there’s a reason I shouldn’t ask too much. So I keep asking, because I feel like if I don’t, they’ll just keep covering it up.

I know they say the papers prove it, but I’m certain they’re hiding it. I just need them to admit it. Is that… does that make sense what I’m saying?
Have you been having periods where you feel unusually energetic and need much less sleep than usual?
Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I have nights where I don’t sleep great, but not like I’m full of energy or anything. I haven’t really noticed that. Is that okay?
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?

No… I don’t think so. Not like hearing someone talking when nobody’s there. I mean, sometimes I get worried or I think about things a lot, but I haven’t noticed voices like that. Is that what you mean?
Besides the issue with your money, have you had any other strong beliefs that other people say aren’t true?

Not really anything else… I mean, not like a whole separate thing. It’s mostly this money situation.

I know my family and friends keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, and I’m trying to hear them, I am. But for over a year it’s felt clear to me that they’re hiding it somehow. They bring up bills, or fundraisers, or trips, and it all feels like a way to cover where the money really went.

So I keep bringing it up and confronting them, because I feel like if I stop, they’ll never tell the truth. But I don’t think I have other beliefs like that… at least not that I can think of. Is that an okay answer?
Have you had any major medical or neurological illness?
Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, nothing major that I know of. I haven’t had, like, a serious brain thing or anything… at least nobody’s told me that. Is that what you mean?
Have you found yourself feeling much less interested in seeing people or doing things you used to enjoy?
Um… I don’t think so, not in a big way. I mean, I maybe keep to myself sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I stopped liking people or things. I’m not sure if I’m answering that right.
Do people ever tell you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?
No… I don’t think people say that to me. I mean, maybe if I’m upset I talk a lot or repeat myself some, but I don’t think my thoughts are jumbled. I try to explain it clearly. Is that what you mean?
Outside of arguments about the money, has this problem made it hard for you to work or manage your usual daily responsibilities?

No, not really… I mean, aside from the money arguments, I still take care of my own meals and get myself to the county clinic and assistance appointments. I keep my things in order like I always have. So I think I’m managing okay… is that what you mean?
Has anyone told you that what you say is hard to follow or doesn’t make sense?
I don’t think so… I mean, nobody has really told me I don’t make sense. Sometimes I worry I’m not explaining myself right, but I try to be clear. Is that okay?
Have you felt as if someone else was putting thoughts into your mind?
No… I don’t think so. Like, my thoughts feel like mine. I haven’t noticed somebody putting them there or anything like that. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I get down sometimes, like anyone would, but I wouldn’t say most of the day nearly every day. At least, I haven’t noticed it like that. Is that alright?
Have you felt that other people could read your thoughts?
I don’t think so… not like people can actually hear what I’m thinking. I might worry what people think of me sometimes, but I haven’t really felt like they can read my mind. Is that what you mean?
Have you seen things that other people could not see?

Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, sometimes I might think I saw something out of the corner of my eye, but when I look it’s nothing. I haven’t been seeing things that other people can’t see, not really. Is that okay?
Has anyone said your behavior seems very odd or bizarre outside of the arguments about the money?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, besides the money arguments, I still do my regular things. I make my meals, I get myself to the county clinic and the assistance appointments, and I keep my stuff in order like I always have. I don’t think people would say I’m acting bizarre, really. Is that okay?
Did this belief about your family hiding your money begin all of a sudden?
Not all at once, no… it kind of started when my income went down. That was, um, about a year and two months ago now. I tried not to make a big thing of it at first, but it’s been going on since then.
Have you found that you have much less motivation to do things than you used to?

I don’t know… I don’t think so. I mean, I still do what I need to do. Some days I’m slower getting started, but I wouldn’t say I have no motivation or anything like that. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?
Did this start after you began using any drugs or taking any new medication?

Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I wasn’t using drugs or anything like that, and I don’t remember starting some new medicine right before it began. It was more just… around when the money got smaller. Is that what you’re asking?
Did this start after a head injury?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I didn’t hit my head or have anything like that before it started. At least nothing I can remember. Is that okay—like, is that what you mean?
How old were you when you first became convinced your family was hiding your money?

I was… I guess I was 27. It started when my income dropped, about a year and two months ago. I didn’t make a big thing of it at first, but that’s when I started feeling sure about it. Is that the kind of age you mean?
